arguments.command:
npm run check >/tmp/check.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; git add -A && git commit -qF - <<'EOF'
feat: expand prompt templates from extensions, the project, and agent_dir

A task that starts with /<name> gets the body of the template with that
name, with pi's argument variables. Templates come from each package's
pi.prompts (pi-durable packages too), then .pi/prompts with
trust_project only, then <agent_dir>/prompts; the first name wins. The
log shows the request as typed, and the thread's comment entry keeps it.
EOF
npx commitlint --from HEAD~1 --to HEAD && git log --oneline -4
